pie: owis eḱwōs kʷe
english: The Sheep and the Horses

pie: h₁súh₁eḱwe moy h₁éḱwos swidyéti ne-kʷe sth₂éh₁yeti. h₁ím stóygʰoy h₂éǵes? h₁ím solh₂wóm dinóm h₃rēǵés ḱóymom h₂éd h₁élh₂m̥. ḱeḱómh₂e h₁ésyo-kʷe ḱḗr trémti. h₁ím sḱéh₃ih₂m h₁n̥dó dukdʰí h₁ésyo-kʷe krépos gʰr̥h₁ménh₁ térye. h₂éyeri me bʰérēti? dwóh₁ dinóh₁ kʷyéh₁tu. h₁ím ne h₂éǵōh₂ h₁éḱwons wóydth₂e.
english: Of-Good-Horses, my stallion is sweating and does not stand. Did you drive him on the road? I drove him for a whole day to the king's village. He is weary, and his heart trembles. Lead him into the shade, and rub his body with grass. Will he carry me in the morning? Let him rest for two days. I will not drive him; you know horses.

pie: pótni nékʷti kʷéh₂soh₂ ne-kʷe sésmi. sríHgos toy h₂wéksos h₁n̥dó wéyḱt. ph₂wéni h₁épi sddʰí gʷʰr̥dʰí-kʷe. gʷʰermóm moy médʰu dh₃dʰí. gʷʰermóm h₂mélǵos mélit-kʷe ph₃dʰí médʰu dh₂pnṓy h₁ésti. h₂ewsér éti kʷéh₂sōh₂? ne kʷéh₂sēsi h₁yód sésesi. légʰtu h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂h₁ te stégōh₂. pótni moy túH lewbʰéh₂.
english: Wife, I cough at night, and I do not sleep. The frost has gone into your chest. Sit by the fire and become warm. Give me warm mead. Drink warm milk and honey; mead is for the feast. Shall I cough at dawn as well? You will not cough, if you sleep. Lie down; I will cover you with wool. Wife, you are beloved to me.

pie: príHe moy h₂egʷnós kʷéh₂seti trémti-kʷe. snóygʷʰoy légʰeti? h₂éǵroy swéh₂h₁ h₂éwih₁ ḱóm légʰeti. h₁ím dṓm h₁n̥dó wédʰe nékʷts h₂énh₁mos ḱolHtéh₂h₁. kʷíd h₁édeti? dʰéh₁yetu h₁ím-kʷe str̥h₃méni logʰéye. príHe h₂ówins wóydth₂e. h₂éwh₂os moy poh₂imḗn h₁ést só-kʷe me ḱéHst.
english: Friend, a lamb of mine coughs and trembles. Does it lie in the snow? It lies in the field with its mother. Bring it into the house; the wind of the night is cold. And what will it eat? Let it suckle, and lay it on a strewn bed. You know sheep, friend. My grandfather was a shepherd, and he taught me.

pie: kʷíd gʷḗn méwdesi? suHnús moy ḱósmi dinóy swṓd légʰesos stéh₂t. ne ǵn̥néh₃s? ǵn̥néh₃m̥. nu h₁ḗdti? mā́dsom h₁ḗdti h₂mélǵos-kʷe píph₃eti. h₁ésyo h₁énih₃kʷom h₂éti h₁rudʰéh₁ti. dh₂pnóm nos h₂éd gʷm̥dʰí gʷéHyōmes médʰu-kʷe péh₃omes. gʷémoh₂ deywṓs toy suHnúm ph₂sih₁ént. príHe kéh₂ilos h₁sdʰí.
english: Woman, why are you rejoicing? Today my son stood up from his bed! Did you not know? I knew. Does he eat now? He eats porridge and drinks milk. His face is red again. Come to our feast; we will sing and drink mead. I will come. May the gods guard your son! Be well, friend!

pie: h₂éwh₂e moy h₁éḱwos h₃sléydʰt ne-kʷe stéygʰeti. kʷós pṓds ml̥dús? deḱsiwós pṓds. h₁éḱwom h₁idʰé dukdʰí wékʷesh₂ mléwHoh₂. h₃ésth₁ h₃sth₁éh₁ yungih₁tó h₁ésh₂r̥ h₁sh₂énh₁ yungih₁tó h₂épos h₂épesh₁ yungih₁tó. h₂éti stéygʰēti? h₂ewsér stéygʰēti. nu h₁ím déh₂nu h₂éd wédʰe.
english: Grandfather, my horse slipped, and it does not walk. Which foot is weak? The right foot. Lead the horse here; I will speak the words. May bone be joined with bone, blood with blood, limb with limb! Will it walk again? It will walk at dawn. Now lead it to the river.

pie: h₂éwh₂e súpniyom kʷsépi widóm. kʷíd mógʰew widés? kr̥snós moy ḱwṓ h₂wéksesi upér sédt só-kʷe gʷr̥h₂ús h₁ést. gʷʰéresos h₂egʰéh₂ súpniyeh₂ bʰéreti. krépos toy éti gʷʰréh₁yeti? ne gʷʰréh₁yeti nu góloh₂. nu gʷʰéros lelóykʷe. nu kʷih₁dʰí ḱwṓ h₂éti ne gʷémeti.
english: Grandfather, I saw a dream in the night. What did you see, boy? A black dog sat upon my chest, and it was heavy. Heat brings bad dreams. Is your body still warm? It is not warm; now I am cold. Then the heat is gone. Rest now; the dog will not come back.

pie: swésor kʷérom h₁épm̥ só-kʷe moy ǵʰóstom h₁éwset. ǵʰóstom moy toy dh₃dʰí h₁ím-kʷe ḱolHtóy bʰr̥h₁wéni dʰh₁dʰí. h₁rudʰéh₁ti HréwdHmi-kʷe. h₂yúHn̥ḱe bʰréh₂ter mē HréwdHs h₃éngʷn̥ h₁ésmi h₂linéHoh₂. ǵʰóstos moy kéh₂ilos h₁éseti? néwoy méh₁nsi kéh₂ilos h₁éseti. nu tód wóydth₂e kʷéros ph₂wéni upér gʷʰermós. swésor tód wóydh₂e.
english: Sister, I grasped the cauldron, and it burned my hand! Give me your hand, and put it in the cold spring. It is red, and I am weeping. Do not weep, young brother; I will smear butter on it. Will my hand be whole? At the new moon it will be whole. Now you know it: a cauldron on the fire is hot. I know it, sister!

pie: kʷíd ḱéywa th₂kéh₁yetes dáḱruh₂ toy h₁énih₃kʷoy h₁ésti. wiHrós moy dʰǵʰémi ḱéyor ḱéh₂dos-kʷe moy ḱḗr gʷr̥h₃éti. yéh₁ōr ḱéh₂dos mḗdeti. ḱḗr moy mudróm h₂éti h₁éseti? mudróm h₁éseti. gʷm̥sḱé téntloy-kʷe n̥sméy ḱóm tksdʰí. ḱéywa gʷm̥sḱṓh₂ wékʷesh₂ toy moy ḱḗr gʷʰoréyeti.
english: Friend, why are you silent? There are tears on your face. My husband lies in the earth, and grief devours my heart. The years heal grief. Will my heart be glad again? It will be glad. Come and weave with us at the loom. I will come, friend; your words warm my heart.

pie: "tód h₁estu", wéwked lewkós deywós wérunos.
english: "Let this be so," said the bright god Werunos.

pie: h₁súmenes moy ḱéstrom h₂r̥Hmóm h₃wáth₂t. h₂r̥Hmóm moy toy déyḱe. kʷís te h₃wáth₂t? gʰóstis. déh₂newi h₁épi wikóme. ḱéstrom h₃ésth₁ ne h₂eh₂nóḱe. sélpos h₂r̥Hmóy h₂linéHoh₂ h₁ím-kʷe bʰondʰéyōh₂. gʷéru h₂éti kapyṓh₂? h₁íd sémeh₂i kapyḗsi. nu ssdʰí mē-kʷe wikés. h₁súmenes moy túH ḱéyweh₂.
english: Kindly, a knife wounded my arm. Show me your arm. Who wounded you? A stranger. We were fighting by the river. The blade has not reached the bone. I will smear fat on the arm and bind it. Shall I grasp a spear again? In the summer you will grasp it. Now rest, and do not fight! Kindly, you are dear to me.

pie: ǵérh₂ont me wékʷesh₂ ḱHsdʰí h₁yéh₂ h₂épesh₂ yunégti. kʷíd téh₂ wéḱsi? bʰréh₂tr̥s moy skélos Hrumptó ḱóymoy-kʷe kʷis nos ne h₁ésti h₁yós téh₂ wóyde. ḱlowséye snéh₁wr̥ sn̥h₁wénh₁ yunégmi skéwHtim skuHtíh₁ bʰéndʰoh₂. tód kh₂nṓh₂ mléwHoh₂-wē? tód kh₂né h₂énHos moy méǵʰye tód kh₂nét. tód ne mérsoh₂.
english: Old man, teach me the words that join limbs. Why do you want them? My brother's leg is broken, and there is no one in our village who knows them. Listen: sinew with sinew I join, skin with skin I bind. Shall I sing it, or say it? Sing it; my grandmother sang it to me. I will not forget it.

pie: gʰóstipotey h₁eǵóh₂ gʰóstis h₂épesh₂-kʷe moy gʷr̥h₂úh₂. príHe gʰóstey wiḱdʰí. kʷóh₁ stóygʰoh₁ h₁ludʰés? tríns dinóns snóygʷʰom pér stéygʰom. h₁énih₃kʷom toy gʷʰermóm. ḱóm mā́dsom gʷr̥h₃é légʰesi-kʷe moy l̥gʰdʰí. túH gʰostíbʰos h₁wésus kʷíh₁ te gʰéldʰōh₂? h₁yód kéh₂ilos h₁ésesi spélom moy wéwke. polh₁úh₂ toy spéleh₂ wéwkōh₂.
english: Master of the house, I am a stranger, and my limbs are heavy. Dear guest, come in! By which road did you arrive? I walked through the snow for three days. Your face is hot. Eat this porridge and lie down on my bed. You are good to strangers; how shall I repay you? When you are well, tell me a story. I will tell you many stories.

pie: h₂nér toy mógʰus h₂éǵroy lóygeti. lóygeti. déḱm̥ dinóns swóy légʰesi légʰet. tód ǵn̥néh₃s? tód ǵn̥néh₃m̥. kʷíd h₁ím mḗdet? ǵn̥h₃réh₂s gʷnéh₂s gʰréh₁mn̥h₂ h₁ésyo-kʷe h₂énHosyo kéh₂nmn̥h₂. h₁ésyo h₁énih₃kʷom léwkt. h₂uksyéh₁t Hwr̥dʰyéh₁t-kʷe. gʷḗn h₁uséwih₂ éti h₁syéh₁s.
english: Man, your boy is playing in the meadow! He is playing! For ten days he lay on his bed. Did you know it? I knew it. What healed him? The herbs of the wise woman and the songs of his grandmother. His face has become bright. May he grow up and become strong! May you be fortunate too, woman!

pie: gʷḗn mógʰus éti swidyéti? swidyéti ne-kʷe bʰéh₂ti. spéḱye h₂éwsōs h₂wést h₁íh₂m̥ h₁yáǵōmes. h₂éwsos nos diwés dʰúgh₂ter tépos mogʰéws h₂epó h₂éǵe. ḱúbʰra h₁ésmey wéyHm̥ dh₃dʰí. wíHre widéh₁yesi? spéḱyeti nos. bʰéwdʰt h₂éwsōs nos ḱléwt.
english: Wife, is the boy still sweating? He is sweating, and he does not speak. Look, the dawn has become bright; let us worship her. Dawn, daughter of Sky, drive the heat away from our boy! Shining one, give him strength! Husband, do you see? He is looking at us! He has woken up; Dawn has heard us.

pie: h₁yénh₂ter téḱnom HréwdHti swépnos-kʷe h₁ésmey ne gʷm̥sḱéti. kénketi tr̥syéti-wē? srobʰéyet ne kénketi. nu h₁ésmey kéh₂nmn̥ gʷéHye. kʷód kéh₂nmn̥? kéh₂nmn̥ kʷid ne wóydh₂e. ḱód gʷéHye téḱnom toy swépnos gʷm̥yóyh₁t méh₂tēr te péh₂sti. nu sésti kéh₂nmn̥ toy sweh₂dú.
english: Sister-in-law, the child weeps, and sleep does not come to it. Is it hungry, or is it thirsty? It sucked; it is not hungry. Then sing it a song. Which song? I know no song. Sing this: little one, may sleep come to you; your mother guards you. Now it is sleeping; your song is sweet.

pie: méh₂ter moy h₁ógʷʰis pódm̥ gʰr̥h₁méni dénḱt. sddʰí mē-kʷe stéygʰes. kʷóterom pódm̥ dénḱt? sewyóm h₂idnéwti h₁éwsetor-kʷe. skéwHtim skélHoh₂ wisóm-kʷe h₁éǵʰs déwkoh₂. méroh₂? ne méresi. h₁ógʷʰis péh₂uros h₁ést. nu ḱód ph₃dʰí th₂kéh₁ye-kʷe.
english: Mother, a snake bit my foot in the grass! Sit down, and do not walk! Which foot did it bite? The left one; it swells and burns. I will cut the skin and draw out the poison. Will I die? You will not die. The snake was small. Now drink this and be silent.

pie: owis eḱwoi kʷe
english: The Sheep and the Horses

pie: kʷíh₁ toy snúse mógʰus ḱéyor? kʷsépi swidyét nu tépos lelóykʷe. h₁ésyo krépos ḱolHtóm? gʷʰréh₁yeti kʷih₁tíh₁-kʷe h₂énh₁ti. nu h₂ewsér stéh₂eti. prḗḱst kʷid? mā́dsom swóm-kʷe ḱwónm̥ prḗḱst. tód h₁wésu. ǵŕ̥h₂enti ph₂wéni méǵʰye ḱóm sddʰí.
english: Daughter-in-law, how does your boy lie? In the night he sweated, and now the heat is gone. Is his body cold? It is warm, and he breathes quietly. Then he will stand up at dawn. Did he ask for anything? He asked for porridge and for his dog. That is good. Sit with me by the fire, old woman.

pie: ǵérh₂ont moy kʷŕ̥meyes uksnés mémsi sérponti. wĺ̥kʷos h₁ím dénḱt? wĺ̥kʷos h₁ím ne dénḱt tr̥nós h₁ésyo skélos h₂wégt mḗms-kʷe púHyeti. tód wédn̥h₁ sh₂léh₁-kʷe léwh₃e. nu kʷŕ̥mins próti h₂roh₁dʰéye. kʷíd h₂roh₁dʰéyōh₂? ḱód h₂roh₁dʰéye kʷŕ̥meyes méǵh₂es péh₂urōs-kʷe mr̥té. pérkʷunos wos swóh₁ h₂ḱm̥néh₁ gʷʰn̥yéh₁t. tód wékʷsperoy trís h₂roh₁dʰéyōh₂. tód h₂ǵdʰí uksḗn-kʷe toy gʷíh₃wēti.
english: Old man, worms are creeping in the flesh of my bull. Did a wolf bite him? A wolf did not bite him; a thorn pierced his leg, and now the flesh rots. Wash the flesh with water and salt. Then speak against the worms. What shall I speak? Speak this: worms, big ones and small ones, die! May Perkwunos strike you down with his stone! I will speak it three times at evening. Speak it, and your bull will live.

pie: kʷíd h₂éwh₂e túH gʷr̥dús? ǵónwih₁ moy sénoyh₁ dʰr̥ǵʰtóyh₁-kʷe sríHǵesi trémmi. ḱóm h₃ósdom h₁áyso tetélh₂eti te. túH ǵr̥h₂n̥téy h₁suménēs. h₁yód h₂yuHn̥ḱós h₁ésm̥ HeHḱús h₁ésm̥. túH HeHḱús? h₁eǵóh₂ HeHḱús nu túH ǵn̥h₃rós. ǵérh₂ontes ǵn̥h₃rṓs h₂yuHn̥ḱṓs HeHḱéwes. nu moy h₂éwh₂e h₂r̥Hmóy ḱl̥nisó.
english: Grandfather, why are you slow? My knees are old and stiff; I tremble in the frost. Take this branch; it will hold you up. You are kind to an old man. When I was young, I was swift. Are you swift? I am swift, and now you are wise. The old are wise; the young are swift. Then lean on my arm, grandfather.

pie: wíHre túH éti ml̥dús. pérkʷunōy h₁wogʷʰéyōh₂. kʷíd h₁wogʷʰéyēsi? h₁yód stéh₂oh₂ tósmey h₁wésistom uksénm̥ déh₃oh₂. h₁éh₁ugʰos toy h₁wésu h₁éy h₁íd ḱléweti. pótni méǵʰye ḱóm gʷʰédʰyēsi? tébʰye ḱóm gʷʰédʰyōh₂. pérkʷune moy tépos krépesos h₁éǵʰs h₂éǵe.
english: Husband, you are still weak. I will make a vow to Perkwunos. What will you vow? If I stand up, I will give him the best bull. Your vow is good; he will hear it. Will you pray with me, wife? I will pray with you. Thunderer, drive the heat out of my body!

pie: h₂éwh₂e wetsós ǵeǵónh₁e ne sth₂éh₁yeti. h₂énh₁ti? h₂énh₁ti h₁ésyo skélesh₂ ml̥dúh₂. h₁ím tl̥h₂dʰí h₁ím-kʷe gʷṓm próti bʰére. h₁yód dʰéh₁yēti sth₂éh₁yēti. nu dʰéh₁yeti gʷṓws-kʷe h₁ím liǵʰtés. gʷṓws swóm téḱnom ǵn̥néh₃ti.
english: Uncle, the calf has been born, but it does not stand. Is it breathing? It breathes, but its legs are weak. Lift it, and carry it to the cow. If it sucks, it will stand. Now it is sucking, and the cow licks it! A cow knows her young.

pie: ǵĺ̥h₂ow nos albʰéh₂ gʷṓws gʰréh₁mn̥ ne h₁ḗdti. h₂mélǵos dédeh₃ti? péh₂urom h₂mélǵos dédeh₃ti nékʷti-kʷe sténeti. h₁ésyeh₂s úderos h₂idnéwti? h₂idnéwti dʰr̥ǵʰtós-kʷe h₁ésti. h₂egʰóm gʰréh₁mn̥ h₂éḱh₃t. gʷṓm dṓm péri h₂éǵe h₁íh₂-kʷe mē l̥gʰyéh₁t. h₁íh₂ gʷíh₃wēti? gʷíh₃wēti h₁yód nos deywṓs priHṓs h₁ésonti.
english: Sister-in-law, our white cow does not eat grass. Does she give milk? She gives little milk, and she groans at night. Is her belly swelling? It swells, and it is hard. She has eaten bad grass. Drive the cow around the house, and may she not lie down! Will she live? She will live, if the gods are dear to us.

pie: h₂énHe moy h₃dónti Hrupyóh₂. h₁óh₃s moy toy déyḱe. kʷŕ̥mis toy h₃dóntm̥ gʷr̥h₃éti. kʷŕ̥mis. kʷíh₁ moy h₃dóntm̥ h₁n̥dó gʷémt? tóy nékʷti h₃dóntn̥s h₁n̥dó sérponti. kʷŕ̥mey mr̥dʰí deywós-kʷe toy ḱérh₂sonm̥ bʰidyéh₁t. nu h₁éy néḱus? h₁éy néḱus. ḱā́m toy wréh₂dm̥ h₁éh₃si kapyé ssdʰí-kʷe.
english: Grandmother, I have pain in my tooth. Show me your mouth. A worm is eating your tooth. A worm! How did it come into my tooth? They creep into teeth at night. Worm, die, and may the god split your head! Is it dead now? It is dead. Hold this root in your mouth and sleep.

pie: ph₂ter dréws péth₁m̥ bʰeh₂ǵʰús-kʷe moy Hrumptó. bʰeh₂ǵʰúm toy tl̥néh₂si? h₁ím ne tl̥néh₂mi HréwdHmi-kʷe. súHnew th₂kéh₁ye h₃ésth₁ h₃roǵéyōh₂ h₁íd-kʷe h₃ósdoh₁ bʰondʰéyōh₂. kʷíd dóru upó stéygʰes? h₂wéyōm h₂ōwyéh₂ h₂isḱóm. téh₂ dʰǵʰémi h₂isḱé. téh₂ dʰǵʰémi h₂isḱṓh₂.
english: Father, I fell from the tree, and my arm broke! Can you lift your arm? I cannot lift it, and I am weeping. Be silent, son; I will straighten the bone and bind it to a branch. Why did you climb up the tree? I was looking for the eggs of birds. Look for them on the ground! I will look for them on the ground.

pie: kʷíd h₂nŕ̥menes h₂éǵroy légʰesi? sóh₂wl̥ me gʷʰr̥néwt h₂érh₃yom témHm̥-kʷe. dréws sḱéh₃ih₂m h₁n̥dó h₁idʰí ḱód-kʷe ḱolHtóm médʰu srobʰéye. ḱérh₂sō moy gʷr̥h₂ús h₃ókʷih₁-kʷe moy kr̥snóyh₁. kʷís h₂éǵrom h₂érh₃yēti? sḱh₃yéh₂i légʰe h₁ím h₂érh₃yōh₂. gʷḗn túH ḱuh₁réh₂. h₁eǵóh₂ ḱósmi dinóy sh₂wéns ḱéwh₁yōs.
english: Man-Minded, why are you lying in the field? The sun was heating me; I was ploughing, and I grew faint. Go into the shade of the tree, and sip this cold mead. My head is heavy, and my eyes are dark. Who will plough the field? Lie in the shade; I will plough it. Woman, you are strong. Today I am stronger than the sun!

pie: h₂énHe mélit wéḱsi? ne kʷid wéḱmi mr̥yóh₂er. tód mē wérh₁s. sémeh₂m widḗsi. h₁íh₂m̥ ne widṓh₂. téḱneh₂ moy h₁idʰé wédʰe téh₂ wéydsoh₂. kúdʰe téh₂ h₁ésti? téh₂ h₂éǵrōd gʷm̥sḱéti. nu kʷih₁téy méroh₂. h₂énHe te meménomes.
english: Grandmother, do you want honey? I want nothing; I am dying. Do not say it! You will see the summer. I will not see it. Bring my children here; I wish to see them. Where are they? They are coming from the field. Then I will die in quiet. We will remember you, grandmother.
